jobs.description:
At Thorlabs, we design and manufacture components, instruments, and systems that transform the world by identifying, enabling, and accelerating key photonics (i.e., light-based) technologies. Backed by a dedicated workforce of more than 3,000 employees worldwide, Thorlabs contributes to cutting-edge research and real-world innovation.

Whether you're early in your career or bringing years of experience, you’ll find opportunities to grow, take ownership, and make meaningful contributions from day one. We know every employee brings unique talents and perspectives that fuel our success, and we seek driven individuals who are excited to make an impact in a fun, fast-moving culture.

The Analytics Engineering Supervisor is responsible for partnering with business and IT stakeholders to define, govern, and deliver trusted analytics assets that support enterprise decision-making at Thorlabs. This role leads the design and management of semantic models, metric definitions, and analytical frameworks to ensure consistency, accuracy, and scalability across the organization’s analytics ecosystem. This position serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical data teams, translating business questions into well-defined KPIs, metrics, and reusable semantic structures. jobs.title: CNC Programmer - 2082 & 2083
jobs.description:
What is the job?
We are looking for a CNC Programmer to support the R&D and Manufacturing departments with programming and machining of new components.  Take an active role in process improvements and promote collaboration and knowledge sharing between departments and team members.

Working Hours: Monday to Friday 8am – 4:30 pm

Who we are?

Thorlabs is a global, industry leading optical technologies company. We are experts in the design and manufacture or a range of innovative photonics products. We use these products in manufacturing and research, from fibre optics to piezo motors. We are the gold standard with optics laboratories worldwide. There are now 22 facilities across the world in 9 countries. Here in Ely, we are responsible for the Motion Control and Optical Tables product line.

Where you will be working?

Our purpose-built facility is just 12 miles from Cambridge, within the beautiful mediaeval city of Ely. There are train and bus links to Ely from Kings Cross and Liverpool Street London, and our site is within distance of Ely train station and Ely Bus station.

What we would like you to do/to see…

jobs.title: (Senior) Stammdatenadministrator (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Als Senior Stammdatenadministrator (m/w/x) stellst du sicher, dass produktionskritische Stammdaten jederzeit korrekt, konsistent und belastbar sind. Du schaffst damit die Grundlage für stabile Prozesse in Engineering, Produktion und Supply Chain – und verhinderst aktiv Fehler, Verzögerungen und unnötige Kosten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Anlage, Pflege und Aktualisierung von Produkt-, Material- und Stücklistendaten (BOM) im ERP-/MRP-System D365
  • Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität durch sorgfältige Dateneingabe, Plausibilitätsprüfungen und Datenkorrekturen
  • Erfassung, Prüfung und Umsetzung technischer Änderungen auf Basis von Engineering-Dokumenten, Zeichnungen und Änderungsmitteilungen
  • Pflege von Artikelstammsätzen, Stücklisten, Arbeitsplänen und produktbezogenen Dokumentationen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Produktion, Supply Chain und Einkauf zur Sicherstellung korrekter und aktueller Stammdaten
  • Verantwortung als Business Process Owner (BPO) für PLM/Bluestar sowie Unterstützung bei Tests und Validierungen neuer D365-Releases
  • Mitgestaltung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von NPI-Prozessen (New Product Introduction) im Bereich Data Management
  • Erstellung und Auswertung von Reports sowie Bereitstellung aussagekräftiger Datenanalysen auf Basis von D365-Daten
